messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | **Nel** | “in the middle of” – locative prepositional phrase introducing the position | Use the particle **の** to link the preceding noun “midpoint” to the following noun phrase (e.g., *人生の途中*). ← “midway of” | | **mezzo** | The exact middle point of a journey | Render as the noun **途中** (mid‑point) and mark it with **で** to indicate location. ← “midway” | | **del** | Genitive marker linking *cammin* to *vita* | Use **の** to connect *道* (road) to *人生* (life). ← “of the” | | **cammin** | The path or journey being travelled | Translate as **道** (road) and attach the preceding genitive particle. ← “road” | | **di** | Marks possession/association (“our life”) | Use **の** to attach the possessive adjective *nostra* to *vita*. ← “of” | | **nostra** | Indicates that the life belongs to the speaker and companions | Render as the possessive pronoun **私たちの** (our). ← “our” | | **vita** | The span of existence of the speaker and companions | Translate as **人生** (life). ← “life” | | **mi** | The speaker as the experiencer of the action | Use the reflexive pronoun **自分を** (myself) as the object of the verb. ← “I” | | **ritrovai** | “I found myself” – self‑locating action (past) | Use the past form **見つけた** of **見つける** with the reflexive construction **自分を…見つけた**. ← “found” | | **per** | Introduces the spatial domain of the finding | Use the particle **で** to mark the location where the action occurs. ← “within” | | **una** | Marks the noun *selva* as non‑specific | Use the indefinite article **ある** before the noun (e.g., *ある*). ← “a” | | **selva** | A forest, the dark environment | Translate as **森** (forest/wood). ← “wood” | | **oscura** | Qualifies *selva* as lacking light | Add the adjective **暗い** after the noun (e.g., *暗い森*). ← “dark” | | **ché** | Introduces the causal clause | Use the conjunction **なぜなら** to mark cause. ← “for” | | **la** | Specifies the particular *via* | Use the demonstrative **その** to point to the specific way. ← “the” | | **diritta** | Describes the *via* as the correct/straight one | Render as the adjective **正しい** (right/correct). ← “right” | | **via** | The correct path that should be followed | Translate as **道** (way). ← “way” | | **era** | Copular verb indicating a past state | Use the past copula **だった**. ← “had been” | | **smarrita** | State of being lost; the way is not found | Render as the adjective **失われた** (lost/missed). ← “missed” |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.
- Line 1: 我々の人生の道の途中で / 人生の途中にある道で / 我が人生の道の真ん中で - Line 2: 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた / 暗い林で自分を発見した / 暗闇の森で自分を見つけた - Line 3: 正しい道が失われていたから / 正道が見失われていたので / 正しい道がなくなっていたため

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Japanese lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita **Line Inventory:** - 我々の人生の道の途中で **Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase itself expresses “midway on the road of our life.” **Target Text:** 我々の人生の道の途中で
---
**Source Line:** mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, **Line Inventory:** - 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた **Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase ends with the past verb 見つけた, satisfying the clause requirement. **Target Text:** 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた,
---
**Source Line:** ché la diritta via era smarrita. **Line Inventory:** - 正しい道が失われていたから **Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the causal particle から links the clause to the preceding line, matching the “for” conjunction. **Target Text:** 正しい道が失われていたから.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1, Target Text: 我々の人生の道の途中で, Back-Translation: midway on the road of our life, Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed., Checks: End Punct OK; Coverage OK; Meaning Drift OK; Comparative Orientation N/A; Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text:
- Line 2, Target Text: 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた, Back-Translation: I found myself in a dark forest, Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed., Checks: End Punct OK; Coverage OK; Meaning Drift OK; Comparative Orientation N/A; Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text:
- Line 3, Target Text: 正しい道が失われていたから, Back-Translation: because the right way had been lost, Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed., Checks: End Punct OK; Coverage OK; Meaning Drift OK; Comparative Orientation N/A; Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text:
``` 我々の人生の道の途中で 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた, 正しい道が失われていたから. ```
